[USER] User is interested in cooking and enhancing the flavor of chicken breast.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for ways to jazz up a plain chicken breast to make it more flavorful.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided several ideas to enhance the flavor of chicken breast, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Marinate the chicken breast in a favorite marinade for a few hours before cooking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Rub the chicken breast with a mixture of herbs, spices, and salt (garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, chili powder, cumin, coriander, black pepper).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Stuff the chicken breast with cheese, spinach, or sun-dried tomatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Brush the chicken breast with a flavorful sauce (barbecue, teriyaki, hot sauce).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Add toppings like sautéed mushrooms, onions, and peppers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Coat the chicken breast in breadcrumbs or panko before baking or frying.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Grill the chicken breast and top with lemon juice or fresh herbs (parsley, cilantro).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and toss with a flavorful stir-fry sauce and veggies.
